known.title: Gate: retention test depends on template delivery that does not exist yet

findings.body:
Gain 4, Work 2, Harm 2
Raise: Test. Case: normal use - running the new retention test in either the regular suite or live CI. `_new_client` creates an app through `forge init`, but `src/forge/app_baseline.py:139–142` ships only the agents `SKILL.md`, without its assistant-module directory. Consequently, this call always reaches the missing-template assertion in `tests/assistant_copy.py:12–13`, before any retention case runs. GUIDE owns future template delivery, but this branch's required storage test must be runnable independently; stage the template in its fixture before calling the copy helper.
